data.title: bn-3mbj: reclaim completed single-use measurement-row stores
data.description: Bound peak disk on full-matrix runs (host disk cannot be freed). Delete each fresh single-use measurement store after its evidence row is recorded; store id is a name not a content hash, no end-of-run pass reads stores. Scoped to primary/cpu_profiles/syscall_profiles/fairness fresh stores; correctness/fault + corpus reopen stores retained. Best-effort. runner 163/163, verifier 187/187, evaluator SELF_TEST_PASS.

data.reason: APPROVED. Safety verified: (1) store identity = sha256(nonce\0track\0row\0variant)[:20] is a NAME not a content hash, so store contents are not evidence; (2) require_store_after is a per-cell is_dir() check (run_child 10834); (3) no end-of-run pass over the stores dir; (4) reclaim excludes correctness/fault (store reused pre/post) and reopen/structural (materialized from shared corpora, store_absent_before=False) via the store_absent_before + track allowlist + kind guard; (5) best-effort with failures ignored, never a correctness requirement. Directly addresses the retained-store capacity/usability constraint. All suites green. open_findings=0
